sources.fact: Container-local tmpfs contents do not survive container stop and cannot be shared as that mount across containers.
Linux tmpfs size/nr_blocks and nr_inodes bound the instance; zero removes the relevant limit. No host setting was applied.

acceptance_requirements: OS aggregate multi-file bound, not admission size or RLIMIT_FSIZE alone
Persistence from compilation to separate execution phase and refusal quarantine
Private durable controller journal outside guest writable limited volume
Actual finite multi-file and inode refusal plus positive below-budget control on exact owner and consumer revisions
Reuse owner/provider capabilities without excluded repository modifications; no production mount/probe or fabricated enforcement
next_action: Evaluate bounded persistent task volume admission/provisioning through existing owner ports; do not replace current workspace with per-container tmpfs which discards phase artifacts.
